narrative: 拳头、揭示性瞬间、一个应该看起来既像被印刷出来、又像被偷拍到的笑点：主体处于动作中途，一块色彩点缀，没有对话气泡。漫画风（Comic）给你的是那一页。
这个风格在此基础上加了一道白色的爆闪，当作画格边框式的光。对于一幅安静的肖像，它是错误的工具；如果你只是给一张照片打闪光却没有墨线，同样是错误的用法。
如果没有印刷法则，你拍的是狗仔风格。如果没有闪光，你拍的是漫画风。
how: 平视高度，35mm到50mm焦段，在动作中途固定机位。墨线勾勒的边缘、网点效果、硬朗的机头闪光爆闪，一块色彩点缀。
不要对话气泡。Prompt: Flash-comic of [Subject], inked edges plus a strobe bang, print and paparazzi in one hit.
when: 一记拳头、一个揭示性瞬间、一个被印刷出来的偷拍瞬间。不要用在安静的人物研究镜头上，也不要加入对话气泡。
vs: 漫画风是那一页，但没有爆闪。千禧狗仔风（2000s Paparazzi）是那道闪光，但没有墨线。
闪光漫画则是两者合而为一。如果去掉闪光，这个风格依然成立，你想要的其实是漫画风。
examples_film: 《至尊神探》（Dick Tracy）中那些印刷风格的脸可以承受一次爆闪。《蜘蛛侠：平行宇宙》（Spider-Man: Into the Spider-Verse）提供了可以借鉴作为色调语言的印刷语言，但不要照搬某一帧画面。
静帧应该看起来像一格爆炸了的漫画。
mistakes: 有漫画风却没有爆闪，或有狗仔风却没有墨线。破绽是只做到了配方的一半。
修正方法：在动作中途，同时呈现墨线边缘和一道白色爆闪。

faq.q: 电影中的闪光漫画（Flash Comic）是什么？
faq.a: 印刷法则加上一道闪光：墨线边缘、网点效果、硬朗的闪光爆闪。一格爆炸的漫画。既不是安静的漫画风，也不是单纯的狗仔风格。

faq.q: 闪光漫画（Flash Comic）与漫画风（Comic）的区别
faq.a: 漫画风是穿上印刷外衣的真人拍摄。闪光漫画则加上了一道狗仔式的爆闪。如果画面只是安静的墨线，你想要的是漫画风。

faq.q: 什么时候该用闪光漫画？
faq.a: 拳头、揭示性瞬间、被印刷出来的偷拍。跳过安静的肖像和对话气泡。

faq.q: 如何为AI图像或视频撰写闪光漫画的提示词？
faq.a: 先写动作中途，然后保留一块色彩点缀。不要出现对话气泡。

narrative: Punches, reveals, a joke that should look published and stolen: subject mid-gesture, one color spot, no balloons. Comic gives you the page.
This adds a white bang as a panel border of light. It is the wrong tool for a hush portrait, and the wrong tool if you only flash a photograph with no ink.
If there is no print law, you shot paparazzi. If there is no strobe, you shot comic.
how: Eye height, 35mm to 50mm, lock-off at mid-gesture. Inked edges, halftone, hard on-camera flash burst, one color spot.
No balloons. Prompt: Flash-comic of [Subject], inked edges plus a strobe bang, print and paparazzi in one hit.
when: A punch, a reveal, a published theft of a moment. Do not use it on a quiet study, and do not add balloons.
vs: Comic is the page without the bang. 2000s Paparazzi is the strobe without the ink.
Flash comic is both in one hit. If you can delete the flash and keep the look, you wanted comic.
examples_film: Dick Tracy 's print faces can take a strobe. Spider-Man: Into the Spider-Verse supplies the print language you may wear as a grade, not copy as a frame.
The still should look like a panel that went off.
mistakes: Comic without a strobe, or paparazzi without ink. The tell is only one half of the recipe.
Fix it: inked edges and a white bang on a mid-gesture.

faq.q: What is Flash Comic in film?
faq.a: Print law plus a strobe: inked edges, halftone, a hard flash burst. A panel that detonates. Not quiet comic, not plain paparazzi.
Comic is live action wearing print. Flash comic adds a paparazzi bang. If the frame is quiet ink, you wanted comic.

faq.q: When should I use Flash Comic?
faq.a: Punches, reveals, published theft. Skip hush portraits and balloons.

faq.q: How do I prompt Flash Comic for AI image or video?
faq.a: Mid-gesture, then: Flash-comic of [Subject], inked edges plus a strobe bang, print and paparazzi in one hit. Keep one color spot. No balloons.
